name: BM Per
description: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that pulsates every 22.96 days; its mean radius is 91.9 solar radii.

radius.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, BM Per: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 91.9 +/- 30.9 (Monte-Carlo)

temperature.source: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 42, Name='BM Per', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4750 +/- 237 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic)

distance.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, BM Per: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 2253.4 +/- 740.1 (Monte-Carlo)

color.reason: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.871 +/- 0.048 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation

text.card: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 92 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 23.0 days.
text.introduction: Its mean radius, 91.9 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 2,253 parsecs away.
text.locator: table10, BM Per: Per, Rad, Dist

notes: The star pulsates; it is drawn at its mean radius.
No dynamical mass is measured for this Cepheid; its mass is left unmeasured.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 258412862056729472 (quality A), from 2012ApJ...748..107P; Gaia DR3 measures none
